module.purpose: Provides the server-rendered organization members settings page, enforcing authentication and organization access, loading member-management data, resolving action permissions, and passing the assembled view model to the members interface.
module.summary: This Next.js server page authenticates the current user, redirects users without a valid organization context, retrieves the current organization and teams through the viewer organizations router, and loads organization attributes and roles using one-hour caches. It derives organization-aware fallback roles and specific PBAC permissions for listing, inviting, role changes, removal, and impersonation, then normalizes attribute options and renders the members view.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administrators managing membership, roles, teams, and access controls. If unavailable, authorized users cannot inspect or administer organization members from settings.
functions: generateMetadata (~L20-27): Generates localized metadata for the organization members settings page
getCachedAttributes (~L29-37): Retrieves and caches organization attributes with their configured options
getCachedRoles (~L39-46): Retrieves and caches all roles available within an organization
Page (~L48-127): Authenticates users, assembles organization data, resolves permissions, and renders members
